ctx.x: How about Elvin Jones? © Fillius Jazz Archive -16-

I met Elvin when he worked with J.J. Johnson’s quintet with Tommy Flanagan, Wilbur Little and Bobby Jaspar, the Belgian saxophonist, in Amsterdam. I had heard about him through Al Levitt, the late Al Levitt, the drummer who was from New York and played with Lenny Tristano and Stan Getz and Lee Konitz and well quite a few other people.
